moments.author: Tigst Assefa
moments.quote: I will definitely come back to Berlin, and then I will break the world record.
moments.why: Her post-surgery vow following a ruptured Achilles during the Berlin Marathon is both dramatic and inspiring.

moments.author: Stephen Curry
moments.quote: Stephen Curry agreed to a two‑year, $116 million extension, staying in the Bay Area.
moments.why: A major NBA star taking a pay‑cut to stay with his team is huge cultural and sports news.

moments.author: Ian Rapoport
moments.quote: Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa suffered an oblique strain and is considered day‑to‑day.
moments.why: A starting NFL QB's injury status just days before Week 1 is a hot fantasy and sports topic.

moments.author: Gianni Demadonna (via media)
moments.quote: The tendon was completely gone when she ran the last two kilometres.
moments.why: A shocking detail about Assefa running on a fully ruptured Achilles—adds to the drama and viral impact.
